Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
Regarding Inferior TB, which states that "opposing minion takes an
additional 1 damage in the first round of combat during strike
resolution":

Do multiple strikes, and multiple strike resolutions, mean additional
points of damage lost?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lupus Australis <jbwh...@dorsai.org> wrote:
>
> Regarding Inferior TB, which states that "opposing minion takes an
> additional 1 damage in the first round of combat during strike
> resolution":
>
> Do multiple strikes, and multiple strike resolutions, mean additional
> points of damage lost?

No. Like Carrion Crows and damage-dealing-retainers, the damage occurs
only during the initial strike resolution of the round.
